Class FixedInstance<T>

java.lang.Object
org.a2aproject.sdk.server.FixedInstance<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the bean type
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.enterprise.inject.Instance<T>, jakarta.inject.Provider<T>, Iterable<T>
public class FixedInstance<T> extends Object implements jakarta.enterprise.inject.Instance<T>
A static Instance wrapper holding a pre-resolved (or absent) value, for use in non-CDI contexts such as convenience constructors and tests. A null value represents an unsatisfied instance.

Usage example (wrapping a concrete value): 

Instance<AgentCard> instance = new FixedInstance<>(myAgentCard);

Usage example (empty / unsatisfied): 

Instance<AgentCard> empty = FixedInstance.empty();
